jbo.2011.3.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2011 本選 実験試験（植物） (2nd round, practical 1), printed pages 1–5 and 7 (PDF pages = printed pages)
jbo.2011.3.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2011.3.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2011 本選, 2nd round, Hiroshima, file JBO_Exam_2011_2.pdf, 61 pages) holds three practical exam booklets, each followed by an explanatory commentary with answers: 実験試験（植物）問題冊子 (practical exam, plants; 18 August 2011, 14:10–17:40), PDF pages 1–15 (printed pages 1–15; page 6 blank), followed by its commentary (PDF pages 16–18, never used); 実験試験（動物）問題冊子 (animals; 19 August 2011), PDF pages 19–39, followed by its commentary 試験解説 (PDF pages 40–42); 実験試験（生化学）問題冊子 (biochemistry; 19 August 2011), PDF pages 43–58 with a list of corrections (問題訂正箇所, PDF page 59), followed by its commentary (PDF pages 60–61). This is the first booklet, 実験試験（植物）, a bench practical: Feulgen-stained Crepis seedlings, untreated and treated with reagent C, are squashed and the phases of cell division counted (Experiment 1), and the flowers of Easter lily, snapdragon and Japanese dock are observed and interpreted with the ABC model (Experiment 2). Its questions are numbered 問1–問9 straight through the booklet (Experiment 1: 問1–3; Experiment 2: 問4–9), kept as records 1–9. Cover instruction 6 (gloves, avoiding contact with the solutions), the light-microscope and stereomicroscope manuals with Table 1 and Figures 1–2 (printed pages 2–4), the materials list (page 5) and the Experiment 1 introduction are in record 1; Figures 3–8, the method of observing chromosome preparations (pages 9–10) and the supplement on making chromosome preparations (page 11, which 問2 and 問3 refer to) are in record 2; the Experiment 2 introduction is in record 4. In 問3 the printed 'とに' (evidently for とくに) is translated 'In particular'. 問5 refers to a floral diagram of the Brassicaceae that is not printed in the booklet. The furigana printed over some terms (実生, 花被, 花被片, 花葉, 穎) are not reproduced. Not transcribed: the cover page and its other instructions (page 1), the request to raise a hand for missing materials, and all commentary pages. The answer sheets (解答用紙, 6 sheets) and the observation record sheet (観察記録用紙) are not in the PDF.
jbo.2011.3.1.translation_credit: © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO); translated with permission

This is the first booklet, 実験試験（植物）, a bench practical: Feulgen-stained Crepis seedlings, untreated and treated with reagent C, are squashed and the phases of cell division counted (Experiment 1), and the flowers of Easter lily, snapdragon and Japanese dock are observed and interpreted with the ABC model (Experiment 2). Its questions are numbered 問1–問9 straight through the booklet (Experiment 1: 問1–3; Experiment 2: 問4–9), kept as records 1–9. Cover instruction 6 (gloves, avoiding contact with the solutions), the light-microscope and stereomicroscope manuals with Table 1 and Figures 1–2 (printed pages 2–4), the materials list (page 5) and the Experiment 1 introduction are in record 1; Figures 3–8, the method of observing chromosome preparations (pages 9–10) and the supplement on making chromosome preparations (page 11, which 問2 and 問3 refer to) are in record 2; the Experiment 2 introduction is in record 4. In 問3 the printed 'とに' (evidently for とくに) is translated 'In particular'. 問5 refers to a floral diagram of the Brassicaceae that is not printed in the booklet. The furigana printed over some terms (実生, 花被, 花被片, 花葉, 穎) are not reproduced. Not transcribed: the cover page and its other instructions (page 1), the request to raise a hand for missing materials, and all commentary pages. The answer sheets (解答用紙, 6 sheets) and the observation record sheet (観察記録用紙) are not in the PDF.

This is the third booklet, 実験試験（生化学）, a bench practical: PCR amplification of the Arabidopsis thaliana phosphoribulokinase gene from cDNA with primers chosen from an amino-acid sequence (Experiment 1), and restriction-enzyme digestion and agarose gel electrophoresis (E-Gel) of a plasmid to find its length and calculate the plasmid copy number per E. coli cell (Experiment 2). Its questions are numbered 問1–問8 straight through the booklet (Experiment 1: 問1–5; Experiment 2: 問6–8), kept as records 1–8. The four corrections listed on page 59 (page 11, line 6: 'サンプル溶液と純水' → 'サンプル溶液あるいは純水'; page 11, line 7: 'M と３' → 'M と4'; page 11, Table 5: 'PCR-1' → '##-1'; page 12: '2 (atomic mass of carbon)' → '12') are already incorporated in the pages of this PDF, which print the corrected wording; the statements follow it. Cover instructions 7–10 (waiting times, PCR start times, order of the questions, reagent amounts), the micropipette manual with Figures a–c, the precautions for the E-Gel apparatus with Figure d, the outline of the experiments (a flow chart printed without a figure number; its two column heads read only '実験' without experiment numbers), the materials list (page 4), the Experiment 1 introduction with Figure 1 and the lead-in to 問1 are in record 1; the PCR set-up and hand-over procedure after 問2 is in record 2; the Experiment 2 introduction, Task 1 (restriction digestion, Table 3), Task 2 (electrophoresis, Table 4, steps 1–6 and Table 5) are in record 6. In step 4) the text still prints 'PCR1' (the tube is labelled ##-1 in Table 5 after the correction); kept as printed. Table 5, printed with vertical text and wells as columns, is given transposed (one row per well). Not transcribed: the cover page with its other instructions (page 1), the request to raise a hand for missing materials, and all commentary pages. The answer sheets (解答用紙, 6 sheets) and the gel photographs taken during the exam are not in the PDF.

Not transcribed: the cover (page 1), the administrative notes on page 3 (reporting faults, gloves on request, taking the booklet home), the assessment criteria (評価項目, page 3) and the general manuals for the microscopes, micropipettes and counter (pages 4–10).

jbo.2013.3.5.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2013 本選, 2nd round, file 2013_2_exam.pdf, 60 pages) holds three practical exam booklets, each followed by answer material: 実験試験（動物）問題冊子 (practical exam, animals; 17 August 2013, 16:00–18:00), PDF pages 1–17 (printed pages 1–17; pages 5 and 15 blank), then 動物問題解答のポイント (marking points with answers, PDF pages 18–19); 実験試験（生化学）問題冊子 (biochemistry, PDF pages 20–32) followed by its answer slides (PDF pages 33–46); 実験試験（植物）問題冊子 (plants, PDF pages 47–56) followed by its answer sheets filled in with model answers and marking (PDF pages 57–60). This is the first booklet, 実験試験（動物）, a bench practical: dissection and external morphology of the mantis shrimp Oratosquilla oratoria (Experiment 1), a stained smear of sheep blood (Experiment 2) and red blood cells in the tail-fin vessels of an anaesthetised zebrafish (Experiment 3). Its questions are numbered 問1–問8 straight through the booklet (Experiment 1: 問1–4; Experiment 2: 問5–6; Experiment 3: 問7–8), kept as records 1–8. The materials list (printed pages 2–3), the instructions for using the light microscope (page 4) and item 9 of the cover instructions (order of the experiments) are in record 1 with the Experiment 1 introduction; step 3 of Experiment 1 is repeated in record 3; the whole Experiment 2 procedure (pages 8–13) is in record 5 and the Experiment 3 introduction and procedure in record 7. Not transcribed: the other cover instructions (page 1), the request to tick the materials list and its administrative notes (masks, gloves, drawers), and all the answer and marking pages (PDF pages 18–19, never used). The answer sheets (解答用紙), the Kent paper sheets and the appendage sheet (付属肢シート) handed out at the exam are not in the PDF.

jbo.2013.4.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2013 本選 実験試験（生化学） (2nd round, practical 2), printed pages 2, 4–8 (PDF pages 21, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27)
jbo.2013.4.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2013.4.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2013 本選, 2nd round, file 2013_2_exam.pdf, 60 pages) holds three practical exam booklets, each followed by answer material; this is the second booklet, 実験試験（生化学）問題冊子 (practical exam, biochemistry; 18 August 2013, 12:30–14:30 and 15:20–17:20), PDF pages 20–32 (printed pages 1–13; pages 3 and 13 are blank calculation sheets), which is followed in the PDF by its answer slides (PDF pages 33–46, never used). It is a bench practical with a bacterial alkaline phosphatase (BAP): its enzyme activity is measured with p-nitrophenyl phosphate and a p-nitrophenol standard line read on a plate reader (Experiment 1), its protein concentration by the Bradford method and its specific activity are calculated (Experiment 2), and a hypothetical carboxypeptidase Y experiment is interpreted from a printed graph (Experiment 3, no bench work). Its questions are numbered 問1–問10 straight through the booklet (Experiment 1: 問1–4; Experiment 2: 問5–9; Experiment 3: 問10), kept as records 1–10. The materials list (printed page 2), the introduction (page 4), the principle of the assay (page 5, with Equation 2 cropped as printed) and the whole Experiment 1 procedure with Tables 1–2 (pages 6–8) are in record 1; Table 1 is repeated in record 2, the definition of 1 U in record 4, the definition of specific activity in record 7. The Experiment 2 introduction and procedure with Table 3 (pages 9–10) are in record 5; Table 4 and Figure 1 (page 11) in record 8; the Experiment 3 outline (page 12) in record 10. In Table 2 the two unused wells of the first row are struck through in the original (shown with a diagonal). Not transcribed: the cover with its administrative instructions (page 1), the request to tick the materials list, and the answer pages. The answer sheets (解答用紙, 6 sheets) and the plate-reader printouts received during the exam are not in the PDF.
jbo.2013.4.1.translation_credit: © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO); translated with permission

jbo.2014.3.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2014 本選 実験試験1 動物学 (2nd round, practical 1), printed pages 2, 4
jbo.2014.3.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2014.3.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2014 本選, 2nd round, Tsukuba, file 2014_2_Exam.pdf, 43 pages) holds the four practical exam booklets (実験試験1–4) one after another, each followed (exams 1, 2 and 4) by the handout of its preliminary session (予備体験); this is 実験試験1 動物学 (Practical exam 1, zoology; time limit 90 minutes), PDF pages 1–6, whose printed page numbers 1–6 match the PDF pages. It is a bench practical: adult Drosophila melanogaster (wild type, white mutant) are observed under the stereomicroscope, dissected in phosphate buffer and sketched, and flies are chosen for a cross. Its questions are numbered 問題1–問題8 straight through (Part 1: 問題1–2; Part 2: 問題3–5; Part 3: 問題6–8), kept as records 1–8. The introduction and the samples and apparatus (page 2) are in record 1; the opening paragraph of each Part is repeated in each record of that Part, and the description of microtube A (page 2) is needed by record 7. Not transcribed: the cover (page 1), the administrative notes on page 2 (paper wipes, waste beakers, reporting lamp or lens faults, reading the whole paper first, not separating the answer sheets, taking the booklet home), the assessment criteria (評価項目, page 3) and the preliminary-session handout (予備体験, 実体顕微鏡の使い方と動物の解剖, PDF pages 7–11) referred to in 問題2 and Part 2. The answer sheets (解答用紙, 3 sheets) are not in the PDF. The emphasis (bold, wavy underline) on 「1匹ずつ」 (one of each) in 問題7 is not reproduced.
jbo.2014.3.1.translation_credit: © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO); translated with permission

jbo.2014.4.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2014 本選 実験試験2 進化生態学 (2nd round, practical 2), printed pages 1–5 (PDF pages 12–16; cover title and time limit, introduction, samples and apparatus, Question 1)
jbo.2014.4.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2014.4.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2014 本選, 2nd round, Tsukuba, file 2014_2_Exam.pdf, 43 pages) holds the four practical exam booklets (実験試験1–4) one after another, each followed (exams 1, 2 and 4) by the handout of its preliminary session (予備体験); this is 実験試験2 進化生態学 (Practical exam 2, evolutionary ecology; time limit 90 minutes), PDF pages 12–16, printed pages 1–5. It is a bench practical: living plants of Arabidopsis kamchatica from a low-altitude (Magosajima, about 500 m) and a high-altitude (Murodo, about 2400 m) population, raised from seed in the same laboratory, are observed and measured with a ruler and a magnifying glass. Its questions are numbered 問題1–問題4, kept as records 1–4. The introduction (with Figure 1) and the samples and apparatus (printed pages 2–3) are in record 1; the opening of the 問題 section with Figures 2–3 is repeated in each record (without the figures in records 3–4), Question 1 and Figure 4 are repeated in record 2 (Question 2 refers to them), and Question 2 is repeated in records 3 and 4 (they refer to it). Not transcribed: the cover logo and notes (printed page 1, apart from the title and time limit), the administrative notes on printed page 3 (using the question paper and the backs of the answer sheets for notes, not separating the answer sheets, taking the booklet home, starting time, writing the candidate number and name on the 4 answer sheets) and the assessment criteria (評価項目: certainty, logic and originality of the answers to 問題1–4). The answer sheets (解答用紙, 4 sheets, with the boxes referred to in 問題3–4) are not in the PDF. The place names Magosajima and Murodo are romanised from the readings printed in the paper (まごさじま, むろどう).

jbo.2014.5.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2014 本選 実験試験3 生理学 (2nd round, practical 3), printed pages 2, 3, 5
jbo.2014.5.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2014.5.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2014 本選, 2nd round, Tsukuba, file 2014_2_Exam.pdf, 43 pages) holds the four practical exam booklets (実験試験1–4) one after another, each followed (exams 1, 2 and 4) by the handout of its preliminary session (予備体験); this is 実験試験3 生理学 (Practical exam 3, physiology; time limit 90 minutes), PDF pages 20–26, printed pages 1–7 (printed page = PDF page − 19). It is a bench practical: preserved sheep blood is diluted and its red blood cells are counted in a haemocytometer under the upright microscope (Experiment 1); red blood cells are haemolysed in a series of diluted physiological salines, centrifuged, and the absorbance of the supernatants at 555 nm is measured by the staff (Experiment 2). jbo.2014.7.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2014.7.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2014 本選, 2nd round, Tsukuba, file 2014_2_Exam.pdf, 43 pages) holds the four practical exam booklets (実験試験1–4) one after another, each followed (exams 1, 2 and 4) by the handout of its preliminary session (予備体験); this is 実験試験4 植物分子生物学 (Practical exam 4, plant molecular biology; time limit 90 minutes), PDF pages 27–35, which carry no printed page numbers. It is a bench practical: PCR products of the blue gene (flavonoid 3′,5′-hydroxylase) from the flowers of four kinds of the transgenic blue carnation Moondust and from the leaves of one of them are digested with HindIII and run on an agarose gel to tell whether each blue gene comes from pansy or from petunia. Its questions are numbered 問題1–問題9 straight through (page 34: 問題1–4; page 35: 問題5–9), kept as records 1–9. The introduction with its figure (the rose pigment pathway, from the Suntory Flowers website, cropped as printed), the samples and apparatus list (PDF pages 28–29), the introduction to the experiment and procedure step 1 (pages 32–33) are in record 1 with 問題1; the introduction to the experiment is repeated in records 2 and 5–9, the description of DNA solutions ①–⑤ (first sentence of step 1) in records 5–9, procedure step 2 (page 33) in record 5, and the first paragraph of step 2 (loading order and running conditions) in records 6–9. The Japanese era years in the introduction (平成13、14年; 平成21年) are kept as Heisei years, with the Western years added in square brackets by the translator. The original's 'どのようなな' (a typo) is kept in the Japanese text. Not transcribed: the cover (PDF page 27, apart from the title and time limit) with its notes, the precautions (注意事項, page 30: reporting used-up reagents, not moving between seats, not separating the answer sheets, taking the booklet home), the assessment criteria (評価項目, page 30), the blank page 31 ('do not look further until the start signal') and the preliminary-session handout (予備体験, マイクロピペット、電気泳動装置、小型遠心器の使い方と実践, PDF pages 36–43). The photographs of carnations referred to in 問題2 and the example electrophoresis photograph handed out during the exam (問題5–9) are not in the PDF; the answer sheets (解答用紙, 3 sheets) are not in the PDF.

Its questions are numbered 問題1–問題9 straight through (page 34: 問題1–4; page 35: 問題5–9), kept as records 1–9. The introduction with its figure (the rose pigment pathway, from the Suntory Flowers website, cropped as printed), the samples and apparatus list (PDF pages 28–29), the introduction to the experiment and procedure step 1 (pages 32–33) are in record 1 with 問題1; the introduction to the experiment is repeated in records 2 and 5–9, the description of DNA solutions ①–⑤ (first sentence of step 1) in records 5–9, procedure step 2 (page 33) in record 5, and the first paragraph of step 2 (loading order and running conditions) in records 6–9. The Japanese era years in the introduction (平成13、14年; 平成21年) are kept as Heisei years, with the Western years added in square brackets by the translator. The original's 'どのようなな' (a typo) is kept in the Japanese text. Not transcribed: the cover (PDF page 27, apart from the title and time limit) with its notes, the precautions (注意事項, page 30: reporting used-up reagents, not moving between seats, not separating the answer sheets, taking the booklet home), the assessment criteria (評価項目, page 30), the blank page 31 ('do not look further until the start signal') and the preliminary-session handout (予備体験, マイクロピペット、電気泳動装置、小型遠心器の使い方と実践, PDF pages 36–43). jbo.2015.2.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2015.2.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2015 本選, 2nd round, Hiroshima, file 2015_2_Exam.pdf, 36 pages) holds the four exam booklets of the 2nd round one after another, without answer sheets: 実験試験Ⅰ 数理生物学 (PDF pages 1–5), 実験試験Ⅱ 生理学 (pages 6–12), 実験試験Ⅲ 微生物学 (pages 13–27) and 実験試験Ⅳ 植物学 (pages 28–36). This is 実験試験Ⅰ 数理生物学 問題冊子 (Practical exam I, mathematical biology, question booklet; time limit 70 minutes), PDF pages 1–5, whose printed page numbers 1–5 match the PDF pages. Although it is numbered as a practical exam, it is a written paper-and-calculator exam (thought experiments on gene ON–OFF networks and the logistic model, worked on paper with a desk calculator and ruler; no bench work, no computer), so it is given here as paper 2, "2nd round, theory". It followed a 40-minute preliminary session (予備体験冊子, separate file 2015_2_HandsOn.pdf, not transcribed) to which the questions refer. One record per 大問 (実験1 with 問1-1 to 問1-3 = record 1; 実験2 with 問2-1 to 問2-3 = record 2). Not transcribed: the cover instructions (page 1) except the note on the calculator, ruler and preliminary booklet, which is kept briefly in record 1, and the assessment criteria (評価項目, page 2). The empty ON–OFF table printed under 問1-1 is given as a figure. Text read from the page images (the text layer is garbled) and translated; the Japanese original is retyped in the .orig.txt.

jbo.2015.3.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2015.3.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2015 本選, 2nd round, Hiroshima, file 2015_2_Exam.pdf, 36 pages) holds the four exam booklets of the 2nd round one after another, without answer sheets: 実験試験Ⅰ 数理生物学 (PDF pages 1–5), 実験試験Ⅱ 生理学 (pages 6–12), 実験試験Ⅲ 微生物学 (pages 13–27) and 実験試験Ⅳ 植物学 (pages 28–36). This is 実験試験Ⅱ 生理学 問題冊子 (Practical exam II, physiology, question booklet; time limit 45 minutes), PDF pages 6–12, whose printed page numbers 1–7 are PDF pages 6–12. It is the written part of a practical: after a hands-on preliminary session in which the students mapped touch-pressure, warm and cold points on their own skin, they answer questions on a data booklet printed at the end of the booklet (①-1, ①-2: bar charts of the average densities of touch-pressure points and pain points in about 100 people; ②-1, ②-2: maps of the cold and warm points on the inner forearm of 5 subjects before and after menthol, and their mean densities). All the data the questions use are printed in the PDF; the preliminary session's own data are not needed (the booklet states they are not assessed). The 問 numbers are compound (問1-1 to 問1-5 under 実験1, 問2-1 to 問2-3 under 実験2), so the eight questions are numbered straight through as records 1–8, with the printed number in the title. The cover's note on what may be on the bench, the introduction (はじめに) and the exam instructions (試験) are in record 1; the introduction to 実験2 is in record 6 and repeated, marked, in records 7 and 8; the data-booklet figures that each question refers to are repeated in its record (①-1 in records 1, 2 and 4; ①-2 in record 4; ② in records 6–8). Not transcribed: the other cover instructions (PDF page 6) and the assessment criteria (評価項目, page 7: the preliminary data are not assessed; answers are assessed on logical consistency and originality). The answer sheets (解答用紙, 4 sheets) are not in the PDF. Text read from the page images (the text layer is garbled) and translated; the Japanese original is retyped in the .orig.txt.

jbo.2017.3.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2017 本選 実験試験Ⅰ 発生生物学 (2nd round, practical 1), printed pages 3–5 (PDF page numbers are the same)

Its questions are numbered 問1–問6, kept as records 1–6. The materials list, the waste-sorting note and the note on discarding preparations (page 3) and the introduction with Figure 1 (page 4) are in record 1; the method of making the preparation (問3, page 5) is repeated in record 6, which refers to it. Not transcribed: the cover instructions (page 1) and the administrative notes on page 3 (reporting microscope faults, asking for more glass, broken glass), and the answer sheets (sketch sheets). Text read from the 200 dpi page images and translated; the Japanese original is retyped in the .orig.txt.

jbo.2017.4.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2017 本選 実験試験Ⅱ 分子生物学 (2nd round, practical 2), printed pages 3–7 (PDF pages 15–19)
jbo.2017.4.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2017.4.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2017 本選, 2nd round, Hiroshima, file 2017_2_Exam.pdf, 56 pages) holds the four practical exam booklets one after another, each followed by its answer sheets; this is 実験試験Ⅱ 分子生物学 (Practical exam II, molecular biology; time limit 85 minutes), question booklet PDF pages 13–23 (printed pages 1–11; page 2 blank), followed by its answer sheets (解答用紙, 4 sheets, not transcribed). It is a bench practical: real-time PCR reaction mixtures are prepared from cDNA of dry and imbibed seeds with primers for GA3ox and the reference gene UBQ (the plates are run by the organisers), and given amplification data are analysed by the ΔΔCt method and with calibration curves. Its questions are numbered 問1–問5, kept as records 1–5; 問5 with its sub-questions 問5-1 to 問5-4 is one record. The materials list and notes (page 3), the introduction with Figures 1–3 (pages 4–5) and the introduction to the experiment (page 6) are in record 1 with 問1. Table 3 (問2) prints the ΔΔCt cell ⑥-③=⑦ as one cell spanning both rows; MathJax arrays cannot merge cells, so it is placed in the second row with a bracketed note. In Table 4 the gene name, printed as a header spanning the two columns, is put in the top-left cell of each table. Not transcribed: the cover and its instructions (page 13) and the answer sheets (from PDF page 24; 問5-1's semi-logarithmic graph is on an answer sheet). Text read from the 200 dpi page images and translated; the Japanese original is retyped in the .orig.txt.
jbo.2017.4.1.translation_credit: © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO); translated with permission

Its questions are numbered 問1–問4 (Part A: 問1–2; Part B: 問3–4), kept as records 1–4. The materials list (printed page 2) and the note on not discarding measured preparations (page 1) are in record 1 with the Part A introduction (page 3); the Part B introduction is in record 3; the method of making the preparation (問3 (2), pages 5–6) is repeated in record 4, which refers to it. Not transcribed: the cover instructions (PDF page 1) and the other administrative notes on printed page 1 (checking the list, reporting faults or broken glass). The answer booklet (解答冊子), the graph-paper sheets 別紙1 and 別紙2, the Nieuwkoop & Faber stage table (資料1) and the bright-field observation summary (明視野観察手順要約書) handed out at the exam are not in the PDF.

jbo.2018.5.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2018 本選 実験試験Ⅲ 分子生物学 (2nd round, practical 3), cover (title and time limit) and printed pages 1–5 (PDF pages 17–22)
jbo.2018.5.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2018.5.1.source_variant_note: The PDF (JBO 2018 本選, 2nd round, Tokyo, file 2018_2_Exam.pdf, 38 pages) holds the four practical exam booklets one after another; this is 実験試験Ⅲ 分子生物学 (Practical exam III, molecular biology; time limit 105 minutes), PDF pages 17–30 (cover without a page number, then printed pages 1–13 = PDF pages 18–30). It is a bench practical: the concentration and purity of a linear double-stranded DNA are found from its absorbance spectrum, the DNA is digested with a restriction enzyme, PCR primers are designed for a prokaryotic gene, and the digested DNA and a PCR fragment of unknown concentration are run on an agarose gel to estimate the fragment's concentration. The booklet has no 問 numbers: its questions are the ten sections headed 問題 (3.3, 3.4, 4.1, 5.2, 6.1.1, 6.1.2, 6.2.1, 6.2.2, 7.1, 7.2), kept in order as records 1–10 with the section number in the title. The materials list (printed page 1) and the notes (page 2, incl. the SI-prefix table, given as an array) are in record 1 with sections 3.1–3.2; the r definition of 3.3 and Figures 1–2 are repeated in record 2; section 5.3 and the introduction to section 6 (with the restriction map, Figure 5) are in record 5; the electrophoresis procedure 6.2.3 (no question of its own) is in record 8. Figure 4 (the 1187-base DNA sequence, printed as an image) is retyped as text in lines of 60 bases in groups of 10, with the position of the last base at the end of each full line (the original marks every 20th position); every base was checked against the page image. The genetic code table (an image without a figure number) is cropped as printed; it prints 'Thr' for TAT/TAC and 'Ara' for GCT–GCG (as in the original). Not transcribed: the cover and its instructions (PDF page 17). The answer sheets (解答用紙, 7 sheets) and the gel photograph taken during the exam are not in the PDF.
jbo.2018.5.1.translation_credit: © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO); translated with permission

The answer booklet is not in the PDF.

jbo.2020.2.1.printed_source_pages: JBO 2020 代替試験 二次試験 (2nd round, theory), PDF pages 7, 8
jbo.2020.2.1.source_format: Official JBO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English
jbo.2020.2.1.source_variant_note: The file 2020_2_Exam.pdf (40 pages) is the written examination of the JBO 2020 alternative examination (日本生物学オリンピック2020 代替試験), 2nd round (二次試験), held on 20 December 2020, 13:00–15:00, in place of the usual 2nd round: one mark-sheet theory booklet of 30 problems (第1問–第30問) with 60 answer boxes; there is no practical or computer-based part and no answer sheet in the PDF. The cover (page 1), the general instructions (page 3), the IBO oath (page 5), blank pages (2, 4, 6, 39, 40) and the closing page "(問題終わり)" (page 38) are not transcribed. The table of amino acids (page 7), which problems 1 and 2 use, is given in records 1 and 2 as a display table and as the printed table (cropped, rotated to reading orientation). One record per 第N問 with all its sub-questions (問1, 問2, …); the boxed answer-box numbers are given as "Answer box: N". Two-digit options such as (12)–(26) are marked as two digits in one box, as the booklet says. The PDF has no printed page numbers; pages are PDF pages. Text read from the page images (the text layer was used only as a typing aid) and translated; the Japanese original is retyped in the .orig.txt.
jbo.2020.2.1.translation_credit: © International Biology Olympiad Japan Committee (JBO); translated with permission

One record per 第N問 with all its sub-questions (問1, 問2, …); the boxed answer-box numbers are given as "Answer box: N". Two-digit options such as (12)–(26) are marked as two digits in one box, as the booklet says. The PDF has no printed page numbers; pages are PDF pages. Text read from the page images (the text layer was used only as a typing aid) and translated; the Japanese original is retyped in the .orig.txt.

The printed page numbers are one less than the PDF page numbers (the cover is unnumbered); source_pages gives PDF pages. PDF page 1 (cover), page 2 (general notes; only the safety note is kept, in record 1), page 3 (do-not-turn page) and page 15 (end of the paper) are not transcribed; administrative notes are left out. The answer sheets (解答用紙) are not in the PDF. The paper twice prints グリコシノレート ('glycosinolate') for グルコシノレート; translated as 'glucosinolate'. The words 'After the liquid has completely run out' in step 2① are underlined in the paper.
